    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActiveCapture
    An active capture ⟨m|R⟧k, with skeleton state ⟨R⟧k.
    AlternationRE
    A regular expression of the form r1|r2|r3|...|rn (n >= 2)
    BacktrackScanner
    A scanner class that, unlike java.util.Scanner, supports arbitrary lookahead and backtracking.
    BacktrackScanner.Location
    An input character along with information about the source of the character, and its line number and position within the line.
    BacktrackScanner.ReaderSource
    A source of input for the scanner in which the input comes from a Reader.
    BacktrackScanner.Source
    A source of input for the scanner.
    Capture
    An unstarted capture pattern ⟦R⟧k
    CharacterClass
    A set of characters (Unicode codepoints), matching any one character in the set.
    Concat
    A regular expression of the form r1r2r3...
    EOF
    Represents the end of the input ("end of file") being reached.
    Match
    One way a regular expression matched some input: the matched text and the span captured by each capture group.
    Matcher
    A matcher for a regular expression with captures.
    Matcher.FailedMatch
     
    Ops
    Tag operations applied to a capture environment at the current input position: first all the starts (⊢k), then all the ends (⊣k).
    Parser
    A parser for turning regexp expressions into regexps.
    Parser.SyntaxError
     
    PredictiveRecognizer
    A Recognizer that decides what other recognizer to use based on the lookahead character.
    Recognizer
    A Recognizer recognizes certain input sequences of characters available on a BacktrackScanner, and invokes a continuation for each recognized sequence.
    Recognizer.Continuation
    The remainder of a computation that can be performed after recognizing input.
    Recognizer.Success
    Represents successful matching of the input stream by a recognizer.
    Regex
    Regular expression support for easyIO.Scanner
    RegExp
    A regular expression, with support for matching and searching an input source, based on Brzozowski derivatives.
    RegExp.DerivTerm
    One summand of a derivative: a skeleton term and the tag operations that produce its environments from the environments of the source term.
    Scanner
    A BacktrackScanner extended with convenience methods for parsing common things like integers and identifiers.
    StarRE
    Kleene Star RE (r*)
    StdIO
    Easy access to standard input and standard output, without fussing with exceptions.
    StringRE
    A string of characters, possibly empty
    UnexpectedInput
    Represents encountering input that does not match the expected syntax.
    VoidRE
